findings: HB Plate 81 (printed p129) shows the separate fixed roller-pinion shaft and paired lateral roller banks, with the chain sprocket centered between them.
HB Plate 82 (printed p131) and SNL Plate 25 (printed plate page297) reproduce the installed pinion/drive-wheel arrangement. Perspective images support topology, not metric measurements.
HB printed p132 gives one unit casting, 23 central teeth, and printed dimensions. SNL144 independently describes one M1541 casting, eighteen roller-pin assemblies and eighteen M1542 rollers per side.
SNL143 nests three leaves in each roller-pin assembly. The rotating pinion assembly therefore has 1 + 18*3 + 18 = 73 physical leaves per side.
SNL215 pinion-shaft assembly has four leaves: M1544, 20297/D89 key and two Q52E plugs. Its two M1409 bushes are separately supported by SNL43 and HB134, not listed as shaft-BOM leaves.

HB132 says the inner 3/4-inch pipe plug is cut flush after installation while the outer head is retained. Keep supplied identity and distinct installed geometry; do not add shaft nuts or M1411 without source support.
SNL189 identifies M1978/M1546 as the inner pinion bearing joint. M1976/M1552 is the outer backing joint. Additional plate-only M1552 rivets remain unresolved.
HB237 nomenclature differentiates M1541A and M1541B; retain those aliases as evidence without inventing additional separately supplied castings absent from the SNL144 BOM.
The 13.687-inch diameter at roller-pin bosses is not explicitly identified as a roller-center pitch diameter. Its interpretation, pinion station, tooth profile and engagement remain open.
HB132 chain pin diameter 1 7/32 inch and hole1.231 inch imply .01225 inch diametral clearance, which conflicts with the separately printed .005 clearance. Preserve both values.
Direct inspection of original SNL144 and215 confirms the one-casting/eighteen-pin-assembly/eighteen-roller BOM and the four-leaf pinion shaft BOM with two Q52E plugs.
